description: On the tabletop in front of you there’s a round white base plate and a white cross-shaped bench support sitting nearby. The left hand stays resting near the plate while the right hand reaches to the cross-shaped piece, grasps it as a right-hand object, lifts it, and places it onto the center of the round plate, adjusting its orientation as it settles; the plate remains a two-hand object only in the sense that both hands hover close, but only the right hand actively manipulates the piece.
